grammarOverrides.from: Use savoir for knowledge of a fact, an answer, or how to do something: je sais où est la bibliothèque; Ana sait parler espagnol; Luis sait la réponse. Use connaître for familiarity with a person or place: je connais la professeure; nous ne connaissons pas cette ville. The present forms change: je sais, tu sais, il sait, nous savons; je connais, tu connais, il connaît, nous connaissons.
grammarOverrides.to: Use savoir for knowledge of a fact, an answer, or how to do something: je sais où est la bibliothèque; Ana sait parler français; Luis sait la réponse. Use connaître for familiarity with a person or place: je connais la professeure; nous ne connaissons pas cette ville. The present forms change: je sais, tu sais, il sait, nous savons; je connais, tu connais, il connaît, nous connaissons.

cautionOverrides.from: Spanish ir a + infinitive has a linking a; French aller + infinitive does not. The source sentence explicitly says Spanish, so this draft retains l’espagnol as the subject of study rather than silently changing the English meaning.
cautionOverrides.to: French aller + infinitive has no linking à. Use je vais étudier le français for this French-course example.
cautionOverrides.reason: Remove Spanish-specific lesson comparison and align localized example

cautionOverrides.from: Unlike Spanish estar + gerund, French does not require a progressive form for every action happening now. “J’étudie à la bibliothèque” can also mean “I am studying in the library.” Use en train de here to teach the explicit contrast; avoid using it mechanically in every ordinary present-tense sentence.
cautionOverrides.to: French does not require a progressive form for every action happening now. “J’étudie à la bibliothèque” can also mean “I am studying in the library.” Use en train de here for an explicit contrast; avoid using it mechanically in every ordinary present-tense sentence.

cautionOverrides.from: French connaître does not take the Spanish personal a before a person: je connais la professeure. The source line says Ana speaks Spanish, so espagnol remains the language in that example.
cautionOverrides.to: Use je connais la professeure for knowing a teacher. Use Ana sait parler français for knowing how to speak French.
